name: REN - DEV - TEMP-01 - Clean renovation_dev Schema_quicklink

parameters.query:
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS renovation_dev CASCADE;
CREATE SCHEMA renovation_dev;

SELECT 'tables_after_clean' AS metric, count(*)::integer AS value
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'renovation_dev'
  AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'views_after_clean', count(*)::integer
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'renovation_dev'
  AND c.relkind IN ('v','m')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'types_after_clean', count(*)::integer
FROM pg_type t
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'renovation_dev'
ORDER BY metric;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, schema: 'renovation_dev', metrics: $input.all().map(item => item.json) }) }}
